note: ep10 hook-first Short (2026-11-14): test of the new Shorts rule after the 11-14 channel read (stayed-to-watch never above 70%). Rules: <= 45 s; frame 0 already shows the ending (the Jan 2000 pile, empty by 86); one story, one twist; the close loops back to the opening question. Same model as nguyens/lines.json. Replay lines carry `month` = months since the 62nd birthday. Every spoken number is checked by tools/validate-ep10-story.mjs. The family are illustrations.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He took Social Security at sixty-two and put every check into stocks. By *eighty-six*, it was all gone.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Everybody said: take it early, and invest it!

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: January two thousand. Every fourteen hundred dollar check goes into stocks. Then the dot-com crash. Then two thousand eight.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: December twenty twenty-three. *The pile is empty.*

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now he's back to fourteen hundred a month. Waiting until seventy pays *twenty-four eighty*, for life.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Was he just unlucky? Since eighteen seventy-one, it lasted to a hundred a little under half the time. About *one in three*, it ran out before ninety.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Investing it early is a bet on the market. Waiting is insurance. Sixty-two, or seventy?
